description: RIISHE capability-upgrade evaluation (work-order Part E) + identity-grounding regressions. Covers the 15 required categories with machine-checkable, structural criteria only, plus the founder-identity hallucination scenarios (unknown person, user-identified person, unverified user claims, config-known facts, conflicts, biography requests, current-info research). Live questions run against the REAL gateway; 'fixture' questions require a FORCED fault (outage/blackout) or an owner-confirmed config change and are reported with pointers to their hermetic unit-test coverage instead of being faked. Difficult and ambiguous examples are included (trick arithmetic, ambiguous units, fictional entities, adversarial phrasing).
